title: Efficacy Study of Amazing Me Program
brief_summary: The objective of the Efficacy Study of Amazing Me Program is to deliver the Amazing Me intervention and assess its efficacy. The Amazing Me intervention aims to help children between the ages of 9 and 11 build self-esteem, body confidence, and eliminate weight-based bullying and teasing. The Amazing Me intervention teaches students to be kind to themselves, their bodies, and to others.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Educators teaching 4th and 5th graders. Thus students will be on average between 9 and 11 years old.

Exclusion Criteria:

* None.
